'''KAORI.''' (born February 28, 1976) is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
KAORI. was born in {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture|Kanagawa}}, Japan. She had used the stage name Midori Kawana (Japanese: '''川菜翠''' ''Kawana Midori'') until December 1999; she had used the name Akiko Kawana (Japanese: '''川菜明子''' ''Kawana Akiko'') prior. In {{aniseries|DP}}, she is credited as Kaori Suzuki (Japanese: '''鈴木カオリ''' ''Suzuki Kaori'').

KAORI.'s most prominent role in {{aniseries|PTS}} is {{an|May}}. She played that character until the end of {{aniseries|RS}}, when May left the series. She returned to voicing May briefly during ''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl''. In May 2012, KAORI. revealed in a blog post that she had been diagnosed with a severe health condition affecting her larynx known as {{wp|spasmodic dysphonia}}, severely impairing her ability to speak.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20120531232201/http://spunkystrider.good.cx/news_kaori/index.html ☆いつも応援してくれているファンの皆さんへ☆]</ref> As a result, neither May nor Max have made any further appearances in ''Pokémon the Series'' following ''Pokémon: The Series: Diamond and Pearl'' except in either flashbacks or brief, non-speaking cameos.

She was a member and singer of the band ''Spunky Strider'' until it disbanded in 2014.
